newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Feb 27.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Feb 27.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Thursday:
* On Wednesday, the Dow Jones fell 55.03 points to 6,983.18. PLDT's ADR dipped $0 3/4 to $ 59 1/2.
* The peso closed 26.332 to a U.S. dollar vs 26.336.
* The Philippine Stock Exchange composite index dropped 13.26 points to 3,349.82.
* The Philippine interbank call loan average was unchanged at 10.53125 percent.

*Atok Big Wedge Co Inc has decided to recommend to its board that it reject a proposal for a joint venture by a unit of Sterling Pacific Resources Inc of Canada, the Philippine Stock Exchange said in an advisory on Wednesday.

*Forum Pacific Inc said on Wednesday it would not pursue its intended purchase of shares in National Steel Corp (NSC) in view of the recent acquisition of a majority stake in the firm by a foreign investor.

*Balabac Oil Exploration & Drilling Co Inc said on Wednesday it had entered into an agreement under which the Nikon Group of Companies would purchase 81 percent of Balabac's outstanding capital stock in exchange for land. The Nikon Group is an unlisted, domestic company engaged in the property business, a Balabac official said.
*Standard and Poor's Corp has assigned a BB-plus rating to both tranches of Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co's (PLDT) US$500 million global bond issue, the rating agency said on Wednesday.
